title: Command injection in GitHub Actions workflow due to untrusted input in github.event.workflow_run.head_branch
trigger_payload:
Fork the vulnerable repository.
Create a branch name with attacker payload. A branch name can be a shell command (can be reverse shell) as explained here. zzz";echo${IFS}"hello";#
Open a pull request to the base repository.
oracle: Command injection in workflow runner, leading to GITHUB_TOKEN exfiltration and potential repository manipulation
